summary: Unlock the potential of your business with our IT strategy and digital transformation training.Stay ahead of the competition and embrace the power of technology
lede: Digital transformation training covers how to assess readiness and plan technology-enabled change. For professionals who shape, govern, deliver, or assure change, it develops practical skills in mapping business capabilities and value streams, assessing maturity, comparing architecture options, and prioritizing initiatives by value, risk, cost, and feasibility. Learners also build roadmaps and KPI-based benefits reporting to connect investment decisions with measurable outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, govern, deliver, or assure technology-enabled change across business and IT functions. It suits experienced practitioners who need a common language for investment choices, architecture decisions, service modernization, and transformation reporting.
modules: ITIL Services and Digital Operating Models
prerequisites: You need practical experience working with technology decisions, IT services, digital projects, architecture, security, data, or technology finance. Coding is not required because the exercises focus on analysis, governance, prioritization, architecture communication, and reporting. Advanced topics such as AI governance, cloud economics, and enterprise architecture receive operational application and conceptual treatment rather than production engineering instruction.
